description: This Java source file defines the ModelFieldType class which models a field type in the entity framework of Apache OFBiz. It includes attributes like type, javaType, jdbcValueHandler, sqlType, and sqlTypeAlias, along with methods to construct an instance from XML, access these attributes, and determine the maximum string length based on SQL type.

classes.name: ModelFieldType
classes.description: A model class representing a field's type in the entity framework, with attributes for type, Java type, SQL type, and an associated JDBC value handler. It provides methods for construction from XML, accessors, and a utility to infer string length based on SQL type.

methods.name: ModelFieldType
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ModelFieldType instance using XML element attributes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type of the field.

methods.name: getJdbcValueHandler
methods.description: Returns the JDBC value handler for this field type.

methods.name: getSqlType
methods.description: Returns the SQL type of the field.

methods.name: getSqlTypeAlias
methods.description: Returns the SQL type alias, if any.

methods.name: stringLength
methods.description: Calculates the maximum string length based on the SQL type of the field, with default values for various types.
